page_title: LIV 3-1 SHU | Liverpool v Sheffield Utd 04/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Stuart Attwell is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' What a chance that is! Cody Gakpo swings the ball into the box, and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
90+4' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+3' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Liverpool get a corner.
90+2' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and it's Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 3 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Andrew Robertson showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the right post – 3:1.
88' The rebound finds Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) replaces Mason Holgate.
87' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
86' The resulting corner, taken by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), comes to nothing.
85' What a magnificent shot by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool). Unfortunately for him, his free kick effort rattles the right post.
84' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Liverpool will take a free kick.
83' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

82' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
81' A cross from a corner kick by Liverpool is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
78' Chris Wilder decides to make a substitution. Auston Trusty will be replaced by Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd).

76' 2 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Ivo Grbic, so the score changes to 2:1.
76' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
75' One of the Sheffield Utd players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Liverpool get a free kick.
74' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the left post.
73' Substitution. Cody Gakpo has come on for Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
73' The substitution has been made. Curtis Jones has replaced Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
71' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.
71' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
69' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
67' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

65' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
64' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and James McAtee trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd).
63' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with William Osula (Sheffield Utd) replacing Ben Brereton Diaz.
62' Chris Wilder is forced to make a change. Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ben Osborn.
62' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Ryan Gravenberch is replaced by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).
60' Substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) in, Mohamed Salah out.
58' 1 - 1 Conor Bradley (Liverpool) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
56' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
54' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the left post is comfortably saved by Caoimhin Kelleher.
53' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stuart Attwell saw the whole situation. Sheffield Utd have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' The ball is cleared after Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

50' A big opportunity is wasted by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Ivo Grbic pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.

49' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
47' Alexis Mac Allister passes to Joe Gomez (Liverpool), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes well wide of the right post.
46' Referee Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' Caoimhin Kelleher was forced into action to thwart Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
45+3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!
45+1' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) works the corner short.

43' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top right corner, but Ivo Grbic thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
43' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
42' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Ivo Grbic.
40' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
38' A clumsy foul by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle.
34' Luis Diaz picks out Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
31' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) plays a terrific long ball forward to Mohamed Salah, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
30' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
30' The total number of attempts is 8:2.

28' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

27' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stuart Attwell stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Sheffield Utd earn a free kick.
26' A cooling break is underway.
24' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a long ball forward to Ryan Gravenberch, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
23' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
22' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) gets inside the box and tries to beat Ivo Grbic with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
20' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
17' 1 - 0 GOAL! Keeper Ivo Grbic totally miss kicks his clearance straight to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who rifles the ball back into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
17' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) sends a long ball in, but Ivo Grbic comfortably gathers the ball.
16' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

14' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. Wasted effort! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
13' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) jumps into a tackle and Stuart Attwell signals a foul. A free kick is awarded to Liverpool.
12' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
10' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
9' Sheffield Utd couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Caoimhin Kelleher (Liverpool) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
7' What a chance that is! Alexis Mac Allister swings the ball into the box, and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
7' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

6' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but Ivo Grbic punches the ball away. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the roof of the net, but Ivo Grbic gets a hand to it and keeps it out.

4' The game is interrupted now, Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on. Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
2' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' CHANCE! James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot to the bottom left corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher produces an excellent save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sheffield Utd will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stuart Attwell.
